name: Azure Retail Prices API — full-catalogue dump, ND96isr H200/H100 v5 re-verification 2026-10-05
notes:
RE-VERIFICATION 2026-10-05 of the Azure records in this directory. Method: paginated the Retail Prices API to exhaustion on the NextPageLink chain, 1000 pages, 879,227 unique meter rows collected, of which 20,079 carry armRegionName='eastus2' and the rest span 73 other regions. Filtered client-side on armRegionName + meterName + productName + type because the API ignores $filter (see w5s-azure-api-ignores-filter-negative). This is the ONLY method that can support a NEGATIVE about Azure meters: a single page is a 1000-row SAMPLE of the whole catalogue, so a missing meter on one page is not evidence of absence.
